title: Never Hand a Plaintext Key
title_zh: 别把明文钥匙交进上下文
summary: A hotel keycard illustrates a scoped, revocable capability handle. Follow a request through NyxID’s proxy and compare the November 27 production catalog with development version 0.79.0.

style: dual-polarity optical glass · keycard, proxy boundary and dated service catalog
